raw_segments.text: No, you see, Maximov turned to him.
What I mean is that those pretty Polish ladies, when they dance the mazurka with our oolands,
when one of them dances a mazurka with a ooland she jumps on his knee like a kitten, a little
white one, and the pan father and pan mother look on and allow it.
They allow it, and next day the ooland comes and offers her his hand.
Offers her his hand, hee hee.
